text: 11日，财政部召开“十五五”时期会计高质量发展新闻发布会。财政部相关负责人在发布会上表示，“十五五”时期，财政部将开展财会监督质效提升三年行动，保持打击财务造假高压态势，持续加大监督检查力度。（央视新闻）
text_en: On the 11th, the Ministry of Finance held a press conference on high-quality accounting development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. A relevant official of the Ministry of Finance said at the press conference that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the Ministry of Finance will carry out a three-year action to improve the quality and effectiveness of accounting supervision, maintain a high-pressure stance against financial fraud, and continue to intensify supervision and inspection. (CCTV News)
